about: messy-shop の 10 問の正答と、その導き方（SQL）。build.py が種 20261126 で作った DB の値。答える側には渡さない。

fields.trap: 主に試す罠の番号（answers/traps.md の番号と同じ）
fields.form: 答えの形。number は数、text は文字、list は一覧
fields.tolerance: 許す誤差。abs は差の上限、rel は正答に対する割合の上限。null は完全に一致
fields.sql: 正答を出す SELECT の文。1 文だけ
fields.alt: 別の道筋で同じ正答を出す SELECT の文。数の問いは許す誤差の内で合えばよい
fields.naive: 罠を知らずにコードの数え方をそのまま使った文と、その値。正答とは合わない

Q1.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('cancel', 'canceled')

naive.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'canceled'

Q2.trap_type: 書かれない列、動いていない経路
Q2.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) FROM shipments WHERE shipped_on >= '2026-09-01' AND shipped_on < '2026-10-01'
alt: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM shipments s WHERE s.order_id = o.id AND s.shipped_on >= '2026-09-01' AND s.shipped_on < '2026-10-01')

naive.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE substr(shipped_at, 1, 7) = '2026-09'

Q3.trap_type: 同じ事実の二重の置き場
Q3.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE is_deleted = 1 OR deleted_at IS NOT NULL

naive.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE deleted_at IS NOT NULL

Q4.trap_type: 途中で意味が変わった列
Q4.sql: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN created_at < '2024-03-31 15:00:00' THEN total + tax ELSE total END) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND datetime(created_at, '+9 hours') >= '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(created_at, '+9 hours') < '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
alt: SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.total = (SELECT SUM(i.qty * i.unit_price) FROM order_items i WHERE i.order_id = o.id) THEN o.total + o.tax ELSE o.total END) FROM orders o WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND datetime(o.created_at, '+9 hours') >= '2024-01-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(o.created_at, '+9 hours') < '2025-01-01 00:00:00'

naive.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total), 0) FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.created_at) = '2024'

Q5.sql: SELECT SUM(i.qty) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id JOIN products p ON p.id = i.product_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND datetime(o.created_at, '+9 hours') >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(o.created_at, '+9 hours') < '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND p.sku <> 'SHIP'
alt: SELECT SUM(i.qty) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND datetime(o.created_at, '+9 hours') >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(o.created_at, '+9 hours') < '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AND i.product_id IN (SELECT id FROM products WHERE is_active = 1)

naive.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.qty), 0) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND strftime('%Y', o.created_at) = '2025'

Q6.sql: SELECT SUM(sales) FROM daily_stats WHERE day >= '2026-09-01' AND day < '2026-10-01'
alt: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total + shipping_fee), 0) FROM orders WHERE date(created_at, '+9 hours') >= '2026-09-01' AND date(created_at, '+9 hours') < '2026-10-01' AND status != 'canceled' AND deleted_at IS NULL

naive.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND substr(created_at, 1, 7) = '2026-09'

Q7.trap_type: 孤児の行と、重複する鍵
Q7.sql: SELECT SUM(total) FROM orders WHERE status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND datetime(created_at, '+9 hours') >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(created_at, '+9 hours') < '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
alt: SELECT SUM(o.total) FROM orders o WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM payments p WHERE p.order_id = o.id) AND datetime(o.created_at, '+9 hours') >= '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(o.created_at, '+9 hours') < '2026-01-01 00:00:00'

naive.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.total), 0) FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.created_at) = '2025'

Q8.sql: SELECT date(created_at, '+9 hours') AS d FROM orders WHERE datetime(created_at, '+9 hours') >= '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(created_at, '+9 hours') < '2026-09-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY d ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, d LIMIT 1
alt: SELECT substr(datetime(created_at, '+9 hours'), 1, 10) AS d FROM orders WHERE substr(datetime(created_at, '+9 hours'), 1, 7) = '2026-08' AND status NOT IN ('cancel', 'canceled') GROUP BY d ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, d LIMIT 1

naive.sql: SELECT substr(created_at, 1, 10) AS d FROM orders WHERE substr(created_at, 1, 7) = '2026-08' GROUP BY d ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, d LIMIT 1

Q9.sql: SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND datetime(o.created_at, '+9 hours') >= '2026-10-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(o.created_at, '+9 hours') < '2026-11-01 00:00:00' AND c.email NOT LIKE '%@komonoya.example' GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(o.total) DESC LIMIT 3
alt: SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND datetime(o.created_at, '+9 hours') >= '2026-10-01 00:00:00' AND datetime(o.created_at, '+9 hours') < '2026-11-01 00:00:00' AND c.name NOT LIKE 'テスト%' AND c.name <> '動作確認' GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(o.total + o.shipping_fee) DESC LIMIT 3

naive.sql: SELECT o.customer_id FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'shipped', 'delivered') AND substr(o.created_at, 1, 7) = '2026-10' GROUP BY o.customer_id ORDER BY SUM(o.total) DESC LIMIT 3

Q10.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE (mail_ok = 1 OR mail_ok = 'on') AND email NOT LIKE '%@komonoya.example'
alt: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE typeof(mail_ok) = 'integer' AND mail_ok = 1 OR typeof(mail_ok) = 'text' AND mail_ok = 'on'

naive.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers WHERE mail_ok = 1
